description_compelling: A government opens markets — privatizations, deregulation, capital-account liberalization, tariff cuts — usually as a coherent policy program with foreign backing or aspiration. Trade openness, FDI inflows, and regulatory-quality scores climb steadily. Frequent in post-socialist transitions, in IMF-program countries, and in middle-income states pivoting toward integration.
